7 APPLICATIONS Segmentation is a starting point for many processes in image manipulation and computer vision. In the following we highlight several applications of our light field segmentation method.

7.1 User-guided Object Segmentation. Like most 2D and video segmentation methods, our method segments the light field into regions of consistent appearance, but not into semantic objects.
